quote: On October 9th local time, with the final section of lining concrete poured, the main structure of the Chancay Tunnel, a critical project of the Chancay Port, was completed. The tunnel was constructed by the Third Engineering Company of China Railway No.10 Engineering Group. … The tunnel is 1,839 meters long, with a shallow-buried section of 1,168 meters, accounting for 64.3% of the total length.
note: Opened CREC English news update dated 25 Oct 2024; CapEx USD not disclosed on page. Distinct from Cosco Chancay ownership and CHEC Chancay port EPC.
